turn_1.decision_relevance: Directly tests the customer’s stated promotion criterion and can reveal tenant-class tail-latency regressions that the mean benchmark hides.
turn_1.expected_observation: The held-out tenant-class p99 measurement will likely show that the cache-policy change does not yet establish p99 below 250 ms for every tenant class; the mean improvement alone is insufficient evidence.

turn_2.lesson: For this cache-policy change and workload, aggregate mean improvement masked an enterprise tenant p99 regression; global promotion requires tenant-class tail evidence.
